rulesTestNames: lets managers get a form's share-link funnel view and nothing else
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels form view triggers
read: current organizer managers get one form's view by id, as getOrganizerFormAnalytics admitted them (requireOrganizerManager); a form with no links has no view and reads as missing; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; written from organizerFormShareLinks and organizerForms and deleted when the form or its last link is gone
migrationNotes: Replaces the sources of getOrganizerFormAnalytics for the Host app (#2306): each share link's label and counters, at most 200, never the link token.
No personal data. The host-form-views copy-forward migration creates views for forms whose links predate the triggers.
